Name: COTS_Camera
Description: This Discipline LDD is intended for metadata specific to Commercial Off The Shelf (COTS) cameras. It will often contain EXIF-type keywords specific to a given camera model. The intent is to hold metadata that does not fit elsewhere. For example, if the IMG LDD has a place to store the metadata, it should generally be used in preference to this LDD.

Name: camera_vendor
Description: Specifies the camera vendor, make, or manufacturer.

Name: Apple
Description: Camera manufactured by Apple

Name: Canon
Description: Camera manufactured by Canon

Name: Custom
Description: A custom or purpose-built camera

Name: GoPro
Description: Camera manufactured by GoPro

Name: Hasselblad
Description: Camera manufactured by Hasselblad

Name: Leica
Description: Camera manufactured by Leica

Name: Nikon
Description: Camera manufactured by Nikon

Name: Sony
Description: Camera manufactured by Sony

Name: camera_name
Description: The name including model number of the camera. This should be sufficiently precise that someone could go purchase a similar camera (assuming they're still being sold).

Name: Camera_Orientation
Description: This class contains the orientation of the camera derived from its internal sensors. These are usually from tilt sensors in the camera. Note that in non-terrestrial environments these values may be of limited use. For example, tilt sensors are of no use in microgravity, and while they might work on the Moon, yaw generally has to be determined by GPS which is unavailable there. These values are not in the Geometry LDD because of the difficulty of precisely defining the reference coordinate system.

Name: pitch
Description: The pitch angle of the camera body, generally perpendicular to the lens axis.

Name: pitch_status
Description: Indicates the trustworthiness of the pitch measurement. Possible values include "Fine", "Coarse", "Unusable". Note that unusable values may be simply omitted.

Name: roll
Description: The roll angle of the camera body, generally about the lens axis.

Name: roll_status
Description: Indicates the trustworthiness of the roll measurement. Possible values include "Fine", "Coarse", "Unusable". Note that unusable values may be simply omitted.

Name: yaw
Description: The yaw angle of the camera body, generally about the vertical axis at the camera location.

Name: yaw_status
Description: Indicates the trustworthiness of the yaw measurement. Possible values include "Fine", "Coarse", "Unusable". Note that unusable values may be simply omitted.

Name: Autofocus
Description: The Autofocus class contains attributes uses to identify or describe the algorithm and settings used to automatically focus the lens.

Name: af_aperture
Description: The size of the lens opening, or aperture value, which controls the amount of light entering the camera during autofocusing.

Name: af_area_initial_height
Description: Specifies the initial height in pixels of the square autofocus box.

Name: af_area_initial_width
Description: Specifies the initial width in pixels of the square autofocus box.

Name: af_area_initial_x_position
Description: Specifies the X (horizontal) coordinate of the starting point of the dynamic autofocus area.

Name: af_area_initial_y_position
Description: Specifies the Y (vertical) coordinate of the starting point of the dynamic autofocus area.

Name: af_area_mode
Description: Refers to the autofocus mode selected for focusing. Includes Single Point, Dynamic Area, and/or Auto Area AF. Mode availability depends on the capabilities of a specific camera model.

Name: af_area_height
Description: Specifies the height of the autofocus box when the picture was taken

Name: af_area_width
Description: Specifies the width of the autofocus box when the picture was taken

Name: af_area_x_position
Description: Specifies the X (horizontal) coordinate of the dynamic autofocus area.

Name: af_area_y_position
Description: Specifies the Y (vertical) coordinate of the dynamic autofocus area.

Name: af_c_priority_selection
Description: Indicates whether the camera will prioritize achieving focus or shot capture while in continuous autofocus mode and if the subject cannot be quickly locked on. Focus Priority will only capture a photograph once the subject has been properly focused. Release Priority will take a shot regardless of whether or not focus has been achieved.

Name: af_coordinates_available
Description: Indicates whether or not autofocus coordinates are available.

Name: af_detection_method
Description: Refers to the method the autofocus system uses to detect focus. This can include methods such as Contrast Detection or Phase Detection, depending on the capabilities of the camera model.

Name: af_fine_tune
Description: Details, typically expressed in micro-adjustments (e.g., +5 or -10), on any calibration made to the autofocus system to improve accuracy.

Name: af_image_height
Description: Height of the image sensor, used in autofocus calculations

Name: af_image_width
Description: Width of the image sensor, used in autofocus calculations

Name: af_info_2_version
Description: Indicates the version number of the camera's autofocus information.

Name: af_point_brightness
Description: Refers to the intensity of the indicator that shows which focus point(s) are selected.

Name: af_points_in_focus
Description: Indicates how many of the selected autofocus points achieved focus on the subject.

Name: af_points_used
Description: Indicates how many autofocus points where actively engaged during the shot.

Name: af_s_priority_selection
Description: Indicates whether the camera prioritizes on achieving a sharp focus before allowing the shutter to release in single autofocus mode. Focus Priority will only release the shutter once it has achieved focus on the subject. Release Priority will allow the shutter to be released even if focus has not been achieved.

Name: block_shot_af_response
Description: Describes the camera's autofocus behaviour when shooting in burst mode. This indicates whether focus is locked for the entire burst or adjusted between shots.

Name: focus_point_schema
Description: Describes the arragements or pattern of selected autofocus points.

Name: focus_point_wrap
Description: Indicates whether focus points wrap around when reaching the edge of the selection grid. Typically On or Off.

Name: focus_result
Description: Indicates whether autofocus thinks the image is in focus or not

Name: focus_shift_shooting
Description: Automates focus stacking by capturing a sequence of images at incrementally changing focus distances

Name: number_of_focus_points
Description: Indicates how many autofocus points are available to the camera.

Name: primary_af_point
Description: Specifies which autofocus point was primary when autofocusing. Typically expressed as an X, Y coordinate or numerical identifier of the autofocus point in use.

Name: Camera_Properties
Description: The Camera_Properties contains parameters describing various physical properties of the camera

Name: exit_pupil_position
Description: Indicates the location of the exit pupil relative to the camera body or lens mount. This is typically measured in millimeters, affecting how light enters the camera.

Name: flash_info_version
Description: Indicates the version of the flash-related metadata recorded.

Name: raw_image_center_line
Description: Specifies the coordinates of the center of the raw image as captired by the sensor

Name: raw_image_center_sample
Description: TODO

Name: shutter_count
Description: Indicates the number of times the camera's shutter has been actuated since it's first use.

Name: Camera_Settings
Description: The Camera_Settings class contains parameters describing shooting mode, processing, and image correction controls.

Name: bracket_set
Description: Records the specific type of bracketing enabled in the camera

Name: color_balance_version
Description: Indicates the version of the color balance adjustments or algorithms applied to the image.

Name: custom_settings_bank
Description: Numeric identifier representing the custom settings bank in use (e.g. Bank 1, Bank 2). The Custom Settings Bank allows users to store and select customized camera settings for specific shooting scenarios.

Name: diffraction_compensation
Description: Applies sharpening to mitigate the softening effects of diffraction at small apertures

Name: distortion_correction
Description: Indicates whether distortion correction is applied

Name: radial_distortion_coefficient_1
Description: First coefficient (A) of a polynomial warp algorithm, similar to Brown's distortion model. Calculates the corrected radius (r') as a function of distortied radius from the center of the image (r) and the coefficients A,B,C via: r' = Ar^3 + Br^2 + Cr

Name: radial_distortion_coefficient_2
Description: Second coefficient (B) of a polynomial warp algorithm, similar to Brown's distortion model. Calculates the corrected radius (r') as a function of distortied radius from the center of the image (r) and the coefficients A,B,C via: r' = Ar^3 + Br^2 + Cr

Name: radial_distortion_coefficient_3
Description: Third coefficient (C) of a polynomial warp algorithm, similar to Brown's distortion model. Calculates the corrected radius (r') as a function of distortied radius from the center of the image (r) and the coefficients A,B,C via: r' = Ar^3 + Br^2 + Cr

Name: flash_mode
Description: Specifies the specific settings for the flash during the exposure, such as Normal or Red-Eye Reduction.

Name: flicker_reduction
Description: Refers to a feature that helps reduce the effects of flickering light sources, such as flourescent or LED lights, which can cause banding or unwanted color shifts in images. Flicker reduction aims to synchronize the camera's shutter speed with the frequency of flickering lights, minimizing artifacts and ensuring more consistent exposure and color balance.

Name: flicker_reduction_indicator
Description: Indicates whether flicker reduction was used during the exposure, expressed as On or Off.

Name: high_iso_noise_reduction
Description: Indicates the method used in applying High ISO Noise Reduction.

Name: noise_reduction
Description: Refers to whether the camera applied noise reduction algorithms to high-ISO images. Typically shown as On or Off.

Name: hue
Description: A numeric scale or percentage of adjustment to the overall color tint of the image.

Name: saturation
Description: A numeric scale or percentage of intensity of colors in the image.

Name: contrast
Description: Reflects the difference in brightness between the darkest and lightest parts of the image.

Name: brightness
Description: Measures the overall lightness or darkness of the image as captured

Name: sharpness
Description: Refers to the clarity and detail in the image expressed in a numerical scale (e.g., 0 to 100)

Name: clarity
Description: Indicates the setting adjustment of the midtone contrast of an image. This adjustment affects the perceived sharpness and detail, specially the midtones, enhancing the overall texture without significantly altering highlights and shadows.

Name: shooting_mode
Description: Indicates the camera mode at the time of capture, affecting settings like focus and exposure. Includes Single Shot, Continuous, or Timer, depending on the capabilities of the camera.

Name: shutter_mode
Description: Indicates shutter mode (for example, mechanical vs. electronic)

Name: shot_info_version
Description: Indicates the version of detailed shooting parameters used for parsing specific camera settings.

Name: vibration_reduction_type
Description: Specifies the method used for vibration reduction stabilization. This includes mechanisms such as lens-based (VR/Optical), in-body (IBIS), and synchro VR.

Name: vignette_control
Description: Indicates whether the camera applied any correction for vignetting (brightness fall-off around corners).

Name: vignette_coefficient_1
Description: First coefficient for vignette correction polynomial.

Name: vignette_coefficient_2
Description: Second coefficient for vignette correction polynomial.

Name: vignette_coefficient_3
Description: Third coefficient for vignette correction polynomial.

Name: Exposure
Description: The Exposure class contains attributes identifying camera exposure configuration. This includes single shot, exposure bracketing, and burst mode operations.

Name: auto_bracket_mode_m
Description: Refers to the specific mode used for exposure bracketing, often expressed in terms of settings. Could include modes like Exposure, Flash, or White Balance bracketing.

Name: auto_bracket_order
Description: Denotes the order in which bracketed images are taken, such as whether they are taken from underexposed to overexposed, or vice versa.

Name: burst_group_id
Description: A number assigned to all expsoures in a burst group within a single press of the shutter.

Name: center_weighted_area_size
Description: Defines the portion of the frame that the camera evaluates for exposure in Center-Weighted metering mode. This is typically expressed as a percentage.

Name: cl_mode_shooting_speed
Description: Continuous Low mode shooting speed indicates the frame rate at which the camera captures image in continuous low mode. Usually expressed in frames per second (fps).

Name: easy_exposure_compensation
Description: Indicates whether the +/- button was needed to set exposure compensation with the main command dial

Name: exposure_bracket_value
Description: Indicates the amount by which exposure is varied in a series of bracketed shots. Represented in stops (e.g., +/- 1.0)

Name: exposure_comp_step_size
Description: Exposure compensation is a setting that allows the photographer to adjust the standard exposure determined by the camera's metering system. The exposure compensation step size defines the increments used when moving the compensation value up (overexposure) or down (underexposure).

Name: exposure_control_step_size
Description: Exposure correction increment per click of the dial when adjusting camera settings such as aperture, shutter speed, or exposure compensation increments.

Name: exposure_delay_mode
Description: Indicates wether an exposure delay was employed prior to releasing the shutter.

Name: exposure_difference
Description: Records how much the exposure deviates from the camera's metered exposure. Often expressed in stops (e.g., +1.0 or -0.5)

Name: high_frame_rate
Description: High-Speed Frame Capture mode

Name: iso_auto_high_limit
Description: Specifies the maximum ISO sensitivity that the camera will automatically adjust to when in Auto ISO mode.

Name: iso_auto_shutter_time
Description: Indicates the maximum shutter speed that the camera will use when set to Auto ISO mode. This defines the slowest shutter speed at which the camera will operate to avoid motion blur when increasing ISO sensitivity.

Name: iso_step_size
Description: Indicates the increments made in changes to ISO sensitivity.

Name: max_continuous_release
Description: Specifies the maximum number of shots the camera can take in a continuous shooting burst.

Name: multi_exposure_auto_gain
Description: Indicates whether automatic gain control was applied to balance exposure across multiple exposures, typically On or Off.

Name: multi_exposure_mode
Description: Indicates which multiple exposure mode was used. Series takes a series of multiple exposures per shot resulting in multiple files. Single Photo will create only a single combined image.

Name: multi_exposure_overlay_mode
Description: Indicates how multiple shots are blended into a single final image

Name: multi_exposure_shots
Description: Denotes the number of exposures combined into a single image.

Name: multi_exposure_version
Description: Indicates the version of the multi-exposure settings used in the camera.

Name: File_Information
Description: The File_Information class describes attributes pertaining to the image file location on disk storage and unique sequence identifier

Name: directory_number
Description: Designates the folder or directory within the memory card that contains the file

Name: file_info_version
Description: Indicates the version of the metadata structure of the file itself.

Name: file_number
Description: Refers to the unique identifier assigned to the image file, typically a sequential number.

Name: memory_card_number
Description: Indicates the specific memory card in the camera where the image was saved, particaraly in cameras with more than one card slots.

Name: offset_time
Description: Time zone offset for the general file modification date/time. Note that time zones may not be defined for space missions (generally UTC is used), but the camera may be set for some time zone.

Name: offset_time_digitized
Description: Time zone offset corresponding to the moment the digital file was created. Note that time zones may not be defined for space missions (generally UTC is used), but the camera may be set for some time zone.

Name: offset_time_original
Description: Time zone offset corresponding to the moment the photo was actually taken. Note that time zones may not be defined for space missions (generally UTC is used), but the camera may be set for some time zone.

Name: Lens_Properties
Description: The Lens_Properties class contains attributes describing the physical properties, identification, and capabilities of the lens in use when the shot was taken.

Name: effective_max_aperture
Description: Indicates the largest aperture (in terms of light-gathering ability) used during the exposure, which may differ from the physical maximum aperture due to verious settings or conditions. This is expressed as an f-stop (e.g., f/4.0).

Name: lens_data_version
Description: Signifies the version of the lens information records which may include updates specifications or characteristics

Name: lens_f_stops
Description: Refers to the maximum and minimum aperture settings available on the lens. This is expressed in f-stop values (e.g., f/2.8 to f/22)

Name: lens_id_number
Description: Indicates a unique numeric identifier corresponding to the lens model used for the image capture.

Name: lens_mount_type
Description: Indicates the type of lens mount

Name: lens_type
Description: Identifies the generation and techology of the attached lens, expressed as a numerical value which can be correlated to identifiers using specialized metadata types such as ExifTool.

Name: max_aperture_at_max_focal
Description: Indicates the widest aperture setting when the lens is at its maximum focal length, expressed as an f-stop (e.g., f/4.0)

Name: max_aperture_at_min_focal
Description: Indicates the widest aperture setting when the lens is at its minimum focal length, expressed as an f-stop (e.g., f/4.0)

Name: max_focal_length
Description: Indicates the longest distance, in millimeters, that the lens can focus on.

Name: min_focal_length
Description: Denotes the shortest distance, in millimeters, that the lens can focus on while still producing a sharp image.

Name: mcu_version
Description: Represents the version of the microcontroller unit (MCU) firmware in the camera body that processes the images.
